verdict.rationale: Flagright documents its own batch API endpoints for creating consumer and business users in bulk. The batch response reports successful and failed counts plus failed records, so it does deliver bulk operations across many items. Coverage is limited to batch user ingestion and retrieval, and nothing shows bulk actions on cases, alerts, transactions or rules. Missing for 10: bulk update/delete operations, bulk case/alert status changes, batch transaction ingestion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
